description: Vercel deployment connector (read-only). Surfaces deployment uid, project name, state, target (production/staging), the *.vercel.app host, inspector URL, git commit metadata (sha/message/ref/PR id), and creator into the local index as `vercel:deployment` items — useful for correlating deploys with PR / Slack history ("which deploy shipped this commit?"). Bearer-token auth. Optional `vercel.team_id` scopes requests to a team. The SaaS host (api.vercel.com) is fixed. Projects / domains / env vars / aliases / logs are deferred follow-ups.
author: Nimbus
